verses.text: Ayik ix lajwi sb'o'ank'e skajnub' Jehová winhaj Moisés, ix yak'anoch aceite winh t'ay yet' t'a masanil syamk'ab'il yet' t'a yib'anh altar yet' syamk'ab'il.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ha heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, haton heb' kolwajnak yik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' winak,

ix yak' yofrenda heb' t'a Jehová: Wake' carreta ayk'e yenhul yib'anh yet' lajchawanh nok' mam wakax smunlaj ix yak' heb'. Syalelk'ochi, junjun carreta t'a chatakwanh heb' yajal chi', junjun pax nok' wakax chi' t'a junjun heb'. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'och heb' t'a yichanh skajnub' Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Cha juntzanh carreta yet' juntzanh nok' wakax smunlaj chi', tzak'an t'a heb' levita yik sk'an heb' t'a munlajel t'a hin kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox hin b'a, icha tastak munlajelal sk'ulej junjun heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix scha'an juntzanh carreta chi' winh, ix scha'anpax nok' wakax smunlaj chi' winh, ix spojanek' winh t'a skal heb' levita.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, chab' carreta yet' chanhwanh nok' wakax chi' ix yak' winh, icha syal smunlajel heb'.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, chanhe' carreta yet' wajxakwanh nok' wakax chi' ix yak' winh, icha syal smunlajel heb' b'aj skuchb'aj yuj winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj sacerdote Aarón.
Haxo t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, malaj carreta, malaj pax nok' wakax ix ak'ji, yujto ha heb' sb'akhanb'at masanil yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová t'a sjolom sjenhjab'.
Ayik ix ak'jikanoch yopisio altar, ix yik'b'at yofrenda heb' yajal t'a junjun inhtilal t'a yichanh altar chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Ha t'a junjun k'u ch'okch'ok heb' yajal t'a junjun inhtilal ol yik'kot yofrenda yuj yochkan yopisio altar, xchi.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u, ix yik'ankot yofrenda winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab, yajal t'a yinhtilal Judá. T'a schab'il k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar, yajal t'a yinhtilal Isacar. T'a yoxil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón, yajal t'a yinhtilal Zabulón. T'a schanhil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur, yajal t'a yinhtilal Rubén. T'a yo'il k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai, yajal t'a yinhtilal Simeón. T'a swakil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel, yajal t'a yinhtilal Gad. T'a yukil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud, yajal t'a yinhtilal Efraín. T'a swajxakil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur, yajal t'a yinhtilal Manasés. T'a sb'alunhil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni, yajal t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. T'a slajunhil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai, yajal t'a yinhtilal Dan. T'a yuxluchil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán, yajal t'a yinhtilal Aser. Haxo t'a slajchawil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán, yajal t'a yinhtilal Neftalí. Lajannhej yofrenda junjun heb' winh ix yik'koti. Haton junjun plato nab'a plata, 130 siclo yalil junjun yet' pax junjun k'e'en niwak uk'ab' nab'a plata, 70 siclo yalil junjun, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ha juntzanh yet'tal chi' te b'ut'an yuj ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite, haton syak' heb' t'a ofrenda'il. Ix yak'anpax junjun k'e'en niwak cuchara nab'a oro heb', 10 siclo yalil junjun, b'ut'an yet' incienso. Ix yak'anpax junjun nok' kelem wakax heb', junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel, junjun nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal yik snhusjitz'a t'a silab'il. Ix yak'anpax junjun nok' mam chiwa heb' yik tz'och silab'il yuj mul. Stzak'anilxo ix yak' silab' yik junk'olal heb', chawanh nok' toro, owanh nok' ch'ak kalnel, owanh nok' mam chiwa yet' pax owanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal ix yak' junjun heb'.

Masanil ofrenda ix yak' heb' yajal yaj t'a yinhtilalkan Israel, ayik ix ochkan yopisio altar, haton juntzanh tik: Lajchawe' k'e'en plato nab'a plata, lajchawe' uk'ab' nab'a plata yet' lajchawe' niwak cuchara nab'a oro.
Junjun plato chi' 130 siclo yalil, junjun uk'ab' 70 siclo yalil, yuj chi' ha k'e'en plata chi' t'a smasanil, ay 2 mil 400 siclo yalil, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ay pax lajchawe' k'e'en niwak cuchara nab'a oro b'ut'an yuj incienso, 10 siclo yalil junjun, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ha k'e'en oro t'a smasanil, ay 120 siclo k'e'en.

Ha sb'isul masanil nok' nok' ix nhusjitz'a silab'il chi', haton tik: Lajchawanh nok' kelemtak wakax, lajchawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel, lajchawanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, aynhej ixim trigo tz'ak'ji ofrenda'il yet'ok yet' pax lajchawanh nok' mam chiwa tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj mul.

Haxo pax nok' nok' ix ak'ji silab'il yuj junk'olal, 24 nok' toro t'a smasanil, 60 nok' ch'ak kalnel, 60 nok' mam chiwa yet' 60 nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Haton masanil juntzanh ofrenda chi' ix ak'chaji ayik ix ochkan yopisio altar ayik toxo ix ochkan yikok Jehová.

Ayik tz'och winhaj Moisés chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yik slolon winh yet' Jehová chi', syab' wal winh slolon Jehová yet'ok t'a snanhal chab' yechel querubín ayoch t'a yib'anh b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, haton smakul skaxa'il trato.
